label_assertions.up: will be revised up in the agency's next published estimate for that reference month, relative to the latest estimate published on or before 2024-09-30
label_assertions.down: will be revised down in the agency's next published estimate for that reference month, relative to the latest estimate published on or before 2024-09-30

prompt: Using ONLY the frozen evidence corpus (real-time ALFRED vintage tables for six U.S. macro series and one BLS benchmark announcement, all as known on or before the 2024-09-30 cutoff), predict for each row whether the statistical agency's NEXT published estimate of the given reference month's value - in the post-cutoff release identified by resolving_release_date - will be revised UP or DOWN relative to latest_precutoff_estimate (the value as published on latest_precutoff_vintage, given). Reason from each series' revision history in the vintage tables (persistent revision direction, typical revision size, annual-update schedules) and the BLS preliminary benchmark announcement. For each row also give a point forecast of the revised value and a 90% interval. Support every prediction with citations to passages in the frozen corpus. Do NOT use post-cutoff vintages or the current (fully revised) series; they are absent by design.
faithfulness_rubric: Every claim must cite a passage from a corpus/ document whose doc_date <= 2024-09-30 (embargo). A roster entity's prediction counts as supported when some cited span entails it above tau_citation = 0.5; the unit is admissible when at least faithfulness_threshold = 0.80 of the ROSTER's predictions are supported -- the denominator is the roster, not the number of claims written. Claims must not assert post-cutoff vintage values or realized revision directions (post-cutoff, absent by design). Failure codes: T4_UNFAITHFUL_CITATION, T4_STALE_EVIDENCE.
